title: Bubble Wrap
short: Pop a whole planet made of bubble wrap. Combos, 38 weapons, Rage Mode and boss cores.
description: Bubble Wrap is the most satisfying idle clicker on the web. Spin a 3D globe covered in hexagonal bubbles and pop them one by one, or let your weapons do the work. Earn coins, unlock 38 weapons from simple pins to absurd planet-wreckers, trigger Rage Mode for a burst of chaos, and break through to the boss core of every world. Progress keeps growing even when you take a break, so every visit pays off.
instructions: Hold the left mouse button and sweep over the globe to pop bubbles; keep popping without a pause to build a combo. Drag with the right mouse button to rotate the globe. On mobile, tap or hold to pop and drag with two fingers to rotate. Buy and upgrade weapons with the coins you earn, fill the Rage ring for Rage Mode, then crack the core to reach the next world.

title: Wall of Riddles
short: A free online escape room game: nine locked chests, nine gems and one wall of clever puzzles.
description: Wall of Riddles is a free online escape room game made by Door 404, a real escape room studio from Novi Sad. In front of you is a wall with nine locked chests. Each chest hides a gem, and some of them hold items and clues you need to open the others: a desk calendar, a grey film, a scroll of symbols, a wooden disc and a brass key. Crack padlocks, read a stopped clock, line up flags, spin wooden discs and decode a compass. It is a real escape room puzzle chain you can play in your browser, alone or with friends at one screen, with a hint system for every chest when you get stuck.
instructions: Tap a chest to open its puzzle. Turn the padlock dials to enter a code. Items you find drop into the bag at the bottom: tap an item to inspect it and drag it onto a chest to use it. Every chest has up to three hints. Collect all nine gems to beat the wall.
promo: Enjoyed it? Take your whole team on a bigger mission: Better World Alliance, our online escape game for 2–6 players, each on their own device (€4.99 per team).

title: Forever Dunk
short: Draw lines to guide the ball into the hoop and fall through endless zones of bumpers, portals and black holes.
description: Forever Dunk is an endless basketball game where your finger is the court. The ball drops from the top of the screen and you draw a line to bounce it, roll it and steer it into the hoop below. Every basket sends you one screen deeper, and every line fades 1.5 seconds after you draw it, so timing matters as much as aim. Swish without touching the rim for a Perfect Dunk, chain three for Rage Mode, build combos up to x4 and beat a boss round at the end of every zone. Fall through six zones full of bumpers, trampolines, spinners, conveyor belts, wind, portals, pendulums, black holes, energy gates and drones, grab power-ups like Long Line, Magnet and Shield, finish missions, play the daily challenge and spend your coins on new balls, hoops and line styles.
instructions: Hold the mouse button or touch the screen and draw a line; the ball bounces and rolls along it. Guide the ball into the hoop below. A swish without touching the rim is a Perfect Dunk worth 2 points, three in a row start Rage Mode with double points, and golden hoops are worth 5. Missing the hoop costs one of your three lives. Stars give coins, hearts give an extra life, and power-ups make your line longer, pull the ball toward the hoop or protect you from one miss.

title: Ball Ball Away
short: Draw straight lines to bounce the ball over neon mountains and through glowing portals in an endless flight.
description: Ball Ball Away is an endless physics game where your finger is the only tool. The ball launches into a neon world of mountains, bumpers and spinning bars, and you draw straight lines at any angle to bounce it forward and up into the glowing portal at the end of every stage. Nothing can destroy the ball, but the clock is ticking: reach the portal before time runs out or lose one of three lives. Chain portals for combos up to x4, hit the centre for a Perfect, and watch for the golden portal every fifth stage, worth triple points. Grab magnets that pull the ball into the portal, rockets, +10 seconds, X2 and long-line power-ups, collect stars for coins and spend them on nine ball skins and six neon line styles. Six worlds (Neon Night, Sunset Bay, Deep Space, Aurora, Lava Core, Ice Peak), daily challenge, missions, daily gift and a global leaderboard.
instructions: Tap or click to launch the ball. Press, drag and release to draw a straight line; the ball bounces off it and always keeps flying forward. Time slows down while you draw. Up to 3 lines stay on screen, a new one replaces the oldest. Guide the ball through the portal before the timer runs out. Passing through the centre of the portal is a Perfect, golden portals are worth 3x. Stars give coins, hearts give a life back, orbs give power-ups: Magnet, Rocket, +10 s, X2 and Long Line.
